visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair and a friendly expression stands in a modern, brightly lit bathroom. She is wearing a white ribbed tank top and a gold bracelet. She looks into a large mirror, adjusts her hair, and smiles while reaching for a white product bottle on a tray near the sink. (2) Close-up shots highlight several white product containers with the brand name 'IKIGAI' printed in clean black font. The woman holds two small round jars near her face against a soft, neutral studio background, winking at the camera and smiling broadly to showcase her white teeth. (3) The camera focuses on the woman's hands as she removes a silver protective seal from a jar of tooth powder. She dips a bamboo toothbrush into a clear glass of water and then presses the damp bristles into the light green, fine powder inside the jar. (4) In a series of close-ups, the woman brushes her teeth, creating a thick, dense white foam. White text overlays appear at the bottom, describing ingredients and benefits. She continues to brush with a cheerful demeanor, looking directly at the lens. (5) A split-screen graphic compares 'IKIGAI' powder foam (shown as fine and dense) against 'Ordinary' toothpaste foam (shown as thin and watery). Another split-screen shows a close-up of teeth transitioning from a yellow tint to a bright white finish under the brand's label. (6) The woman holds a white bottle of mouthwash and pours a clear liquid into a small glass. She takes a sip, swishes it in her mouth with puffed cheeks, and then smiles with a refreshed, satisfied look, touching her cheek with one finger. (7) The full IKIGAI oral care line is arranged on a white surface with soft shadows. The woman reappears in a cozy indoor setting, holding a jar and smiling warmly at the camera. She makes a peace sign gesture as the video fades out.

(4) [Subtitle]: 才發現 原來口腔保養 也可以這麼療癒！(5) [Subtitle]: 用法很簡單 拆開密封鋁膜 蓋緊蓋子 翻轉搖晃 8~10 次. (6) [Subtitle]: 開蓋時朝上 避免粉末倒出. (7) [Subtitle]: 沾濕牙刷 甩掉多餘水分 於內蓋沾取適量牙粉 就可以開始刷牙了！ (8) [Subtitle]: 超細緻微米級粉末 溫和不傷牙. (17) [Subtitle]: 山梨醇保持口腔保濕 薄荷讓口氣好清新. (18) [Subtitle]: 就像給口腔敷了面膜 不只清爽還很舒壓. (19) [Subtitle]: IKIGAI 是CSD中衛新推出的生活品牌. (20) [Subtitle]: 不只是口腔清潔 更是一種對美好生活的追求. (21) [Subtitle]: 牙粉改變我對刷牙的想像 推薦你也試試它的神奇清潔力. (22) [Subtitle]: 記得配合正確刷牙習慣 ❤️.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long, straight brown hair, wearing a white ribbed tank top and a gold bracelet.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary scene is a modern bathroom with a large mirror, marble countertops, and gray wall tiles. Secondary shots include a minimalist white studio background and a cozy indoor bedroom setting with soft lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a bright, cheerful pop melody characterized by rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming and a light electronic beat. A female voice with a warm and energetic Mandarin accent begins narrating, speaking at a clear, conversational pace with high tonal clarity. (2) The narration remains consistent as the speaker introduces the 'IKIGAI' brand. The music maintains a steady 120 BPM tempo in a major key, providing a positive and uplifting atmosphere without any percussive interruptions or harsh transients. (3) During the instructional phase, the vocal delivery remains enunciated and professional. There is a continuous overlap between the voice and the background music, with the speech level sitting comfortably above the instrumental bed for perfect intelligibility. (4) A short, realistic 'liquid pouring' sound effect occurs around the 50-second mark, signifying the mouthwash being used. This transient sound has a clean spectral profile and is mixed at a moderate volume that does not mask the narrator's voice. (5) In the final phase, the narrator's tone becomes more soothing and encouraging as she concludes the review. The music continues its upbeat loop until the very end, where both the voice and the instrumental track undergo a smooth fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Product Introduction -> Usage Tutorial -> Performance Comparison -> Complementary Product -> Brand Context -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive advertisement and lifestyle vlog to promote IKIGAI oral care products. It positions the act of tooth brushing as a therapeutic 'Me Time' ritual rather than a chore. By combining instructional content with aesthetic visuals and a performance comparison, it seeks to convince viewers of the product's superior cleaning power and premium quality.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a dedicated showcase of the brand 'IKIGAI', including a detailed tutorial, ingredient highlights, brand history (CSD), and a call to action to try the product.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses split-screen comparisons to provide visual proof of product efficacy, a common and persuasive technique in beauty and personal care marketing.
